note: Tempdoc 663 — the ONE AI-engine lifecycle verdict derivation. `BrainSurface.deriveAiState()` used to reconcile installStatus/busy-flags/runtimeStatus.onnxFeatures/the unified runtime/a raw inference read by a hand-ordered precedence ladder (the representation-drift class this register exists to make unwritable). `computeAiEngineVerdict` (state/aiVerdict.ts) is now the ONE place that reads `installStatus?.state`/`onnxFeatures` to decide the AI-engine lifecycle; every other shell-v0 site must consume its result, not re-derive from those raw fields. Mirrors check-verdict-derivation / check-folder-status-derivation.
predicatePatternNote: Tempdoc 737 §12c: the runtime-state register (governance/runtime-state.v1.json) delegates FE runtime-state governance to THIS gate. The authority engine-axis fields projected onto the /api/status inference block (engineState/chatEnabledSpec) are added to the predicate so they, too, are read ONLY in the seam (aiVerdict.ts) and the store authority (aiStateStore.ts) — any other shell-v0 site reading them re-forks the AI-engine lifecycle. procedure/engineReason are intentionally NOT guarded (too generic — false-positive risk); guarding chatEnabledSpec+engineState already locks the soft-off / engine-axis derivation to the seam.

allowedNotes.modules/ui-web/src/shell-v0/state/chatRe: Spec A F1/F8: pure reason-code selectors called only by aiStateStore.buildSnapshot to project chatFailureReason/chatUnloadedReason. chatEnabledSpec === false suppresses these notices when the person switched chat off; these helpers do not derive an engine lifecycle kind, read install/onnx state, or open a second status source. Surfaces consume the store's reason fields and AiState.aiEngine remains derived by computeAiEngineVerdict.
allowedNotes.modules/ui-web/src/shell-v0/state/aiStat: Tempdoc 737 §12c: the store authority reads the raw runtime-authority fields (status.inference.engineState/chatEnabledSpec/procedure/engineReason) in exactly two places — computeRuntime (resolves the engine mode, preferring the authority) and buildSnapshot (feeds them into computeAiEngineVerdict) — plus the soft-off chat-capability guard in computeCapabilities. This is the store-level single authority (like 594/595/596), not a re-fork; every OTHER surface consumes AiState.aiEngine / AiState.capabilities, not these raw fields.
allowedNotes.modules/ui-web/src/shell-v0/views/BrainS: installStalled() reads installStatus.state === 'running' to detect a STALE in-progress install (paired with isAiInstallLive's staleness window) — a distinct question from the lifecycle KIND computeAiEngineVerdict answers, not a re-derivation of it. Every OTHER read of installStatus.state/onnxFeatures in this file was fixed to consume computeAiEngineVerdict instead (tempdoc 663) before this allow-list entry was added — re-check with a fresh grep before assuming new occurrences are equally legitimate.
